entities.name: Query 768-aa protein
observations: The sequence is 768 aa long and contains a Glyco_hydro_47 (PF01532) domain at residues 294-764 with i-Evalue 8.2e-143.
The sequence also contains an N-terminal Rad10-like domain at residues 80-199.
Closest reviewed homologs share about 55% identity over roughly 62% of the query and are annotated as GH47 alpha-1,2-mannosidases.
Exact substrate specificity is inferred from homology because the query itself was not experimentally assayed.

entities.name: Alpha-1,2-mannosidase
observations: Catalyzes hydrolytic removal of terminal alpha-1,2-linked mannose residues from high-mannose N-glycans.
The query assignment is strongly supported by five reviewed homologs, while exact substrate range remains homology-supported.

entities.name: GH47 N-glycan trimming
observations: Man9GlcNAc2 + 4 H2O -> Man5GlcNAc2 + 4 beta-D-mannose is the curated representative reaction.
An alternative Man8GlcNAc2 substrate variant releases 3 beta-D-mannose and produces Man5GlcNAc2.
Associated Rhea identifiers include RHEA:56008, RHEA:56028, RHEA:14356/14367, and RHEA:14358/14367.

entities.name: GH47 metal dependence
observations: Calcium ion is used or required by the homologous GH47 enzymes; magnesium can substitute with lower efficiency in most reported homologs.
Homolog records support a calcium-binding feature and proton-donor catalytic residue.
